newsitem.title: UK: Shield Diagnostics plunges on sample warning.
newsitem.headline: Shield Diagnostics plunges on sample warning.

text.p: Shares in Shield Diagnostics lost more than half its value on Friday after the company warned that some of its U.S. trial samples may lead to misleading conclusions after mishandling during storage.
The shares dived 290 pence to 515 minutes after the announcement, having earlier touched a new year high of 928p.

Thomas Geimer, biotechnology analyst at Henry Cooke Lumsden, criticised the company for allowing the share price to race away in recent weeks when "they don't even know if the product correlates to a use that a regulatory authority would approve."
The group's share price rose sharply after publication of a document, the AFT Newsletter, earlier this year and "initial positive results" from a UK trial published on February 21.
"The product may be valid and be fine," Geimer said, but he added that the problems with the U.S. trial showed the need for investors to be very selective in this market.
